biggest_catch: Both you AND the person you refer must be active TriEagle customers for the reward to be issued, the friend must complete a new online enrollment with your account number, and the reward takes 1-2 billing cycles.
catches: You must be an active TriEagle Energy customer with an account number; the referee must be a new TriEagle customer who completes enrollment online at trieagleenergy.com using your account number — and BOTH must be active customers for you to receive the reward.
Base reward per the T&C is $25 per new account; the 'up to $75' headline is achieved by choosing $75 toward energy-efficient products instead of the $25 Visa prepaid card or $25 gift cards.
Reward takes 1 to 2 billing cycles to process and be issued.
Account number should only be shared with personal friends or family; non-personal/commercial use can lead to suspension.
TriEagle can cancel, modify, or suspend the program or your participation at any time without notice.
Savings framing: rewards offset future spending (energy-efficient products or prepaid cards), not cash income; you must already be a TriEagle customer to earn.

steps: Log in to your TriEagle Energy account and find your account number on your invoice.
Share your account number with a personal friend or family member.
The friend enrolls as a new TriEagle customer online at trieagleenergy.com, entering your account number in the web code box (or providing it to the rep if enrolling by phone).
Both you and the friend remain active TriEagle customers.
Choose your Triple Up Reward ($25 gift cards, $25 Visa Prepaid Card, or $75 toward energy-efficient products), issued after 1-2 billing cycles.
timing: Reward issued 1-2 billing cycles after qualifying enrollment; the program can be modified or terminated by TriEagle at any time.
